biological_replicate: Cell culture experiments for proteomic (SGBS and 3T3-L1) data analysis were performed in triplicates
experimental_design: time-course comparison of SGBS and 3T3-L1 adipogenesis

studied the temporal dynamics of transcriptome, proteome, central carbon metabolites, and the acetyl- and phosphoproteome during adipogenesis using LC-MS/MS combined with PTM enrichment strategies on human (SGBS) and mouse (3T3-L1) adipocyte models
factor_value: cell line (SGBS, 3T3-L1), differentiation stage (preadipocyte, immature, mature)
distinguishing between preadipocytes (SGBS/3T3-L1, d0), immature (SGBS, d6; 3T3-L1, d5) and mature adipocytes (SGBS, d12; 3T3-L1, d10)
number_of_samples: preadipocytes (SGBS/3T3-L1, d0), immature (SGBS, d6; 3T3-L1, d5) and mature adipocytes (SGBS, d12; 3T3-L1, d10) ... n = 3, for all proteomics analysis
